tools.name: list_coverages
tools.description: List the insurance coverages Alishahi Insurance quotes, with a link to each coverage's page.

tools.name: get_quote_questions
tools.description: Get the questions to ask for one coverage (names, types and allowed choices). All are optional.

tools.name: submit_quote_request
tools.description: Send the person's quote request to Sam Alishahi, a licensed independent insurance broker, who will contact them. Only call after the person has confirmed they want to be contacted. Use real values from the person; if a field is unknown, leave it out.

tools.name: find_insurance_company
tools.description: Look up a U.S. property and casualty insurance company by name or NAIC number in Alishahi Insurance's directory (built from state regulators' public company lists): where it is admitted (licensed), where it is an eligible surplus lines insurer, the lines it is licensed for, its premium rank by line

tools.name: insurance_companies_in_state
tools.description: List the property and casualty insurers on a state's regulator lists: admitted (licensed) companies and eligible surplus lines insurers, with NAIC numbers and licensed lines. Optional filters: status 'ad' or 'sl', and a line of business.

tools.name: who_writes_line_in_state
tools.description: Who actually writes a line of insurance in a state: companies ranked by direct premium written where the regulator publishes every company (CA, TX, IL, NC, SD, WI), otherwise the licensed companies; the directory page for the state and line is the source to cite. Use it to tell someone which insurer

tools.name: who_is_likely_to_insure
tools.description: Given a plain-English description of what someone needs insured (what, where, anything unusual: claims, cancellations, age of the home or roof, the kind of business, hazards), says which insurers are likely to consider it, in order: admitted carriers that write that line in that state, then surplus

tools.name: get_application
tools.description: Read a quote application Sam Alishahi started from the person's email: every field, its allowed choices, what's filled in and what's still required. The application_id and token are in Sam's reply email (Reference APP-<id>).

tools.name: complete_application
tools.description: Send the person's answers for an application Sam Alishahi started. Only send what the person told you or confirmed; leave unknown fields out. Returns the updated application with any rejected answers and why.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_application · Private data: submit_quote_request, get_application · Public sink: submit_quote_request, find_insurance_company, get_application, complete_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_application · Private data: submit_quote_request, get_application · Public sink: submit_quote_request, find_insurance_company, get_application, complete_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "submit_quote_request" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Send the person's quote request to Sam Alishahi, a licensed independent insurance broker, who will contact them. Only call after the person has confirmed they want to be contacted." → after: "Send the person's quote request to Sam Alishahi, a licensed independent insurance broker, who will contact them. Only call after the person has confirmed they want to be contacted. Use real values from the person; if a field is unknown, leave it out."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
